texte.Décision automatisée à effet juridique o: Automated decision with legal or similarly significant effect
texte.Décision fondée EXCLUSIVEMENT sur un tra: Decision based SOLELY on automated processing, including profiling
texte.Décision légitime, à condition d’être ap: A legitimate decision, provided it is enforced. Prohibiting without a means of detecting it produces clandestine use: generated code gets in anyway, and without any of the checks in point #.
texte.Décisions automatisées, scoring et inter: Automated decisions, scoring and human intervention
texte.Décisions de désactivation temporaire ou: Decisions to temporarily or permanently deactivate driver accounts
texte.Déclaration UE de conformité et marquage: EU declaration of conformity and CE marking
texte.Déclaration écrite tenue à disposition d: Written declaration kept at the disposal of the authorities for ten years, and affixing of the CE marking before placing on the market.
texte.Déclarer le périmètre avant de le peser: Declare the scope before weighing it
texte.Déclarer, famille par famille, où en est: Declare, family by family, how well the system is controlled — and state the baseline (Low, Moderate, High) you measure yourself against. The resulting rate feeds the compliance index, in the same way as the other ten standards.
texte.Déclarez d’abord la criticité de la fonc: First declare the criticality of the function supported: as long as it is not declared, nothing is counted, because a rate on nine clauses when fifteen are due would be falsely reassuring. Then look at the two the authority opens first: the unrestricted right of audit (paragraph #, e) and the exit strategy (paragraph #, f).
texte.Déclarez la criticité, cochez les seuils: Declare the criticality, tick the thresholds reached, then timestamp awareness and classification. The clock has two limits: four hours from classification, twenty-four hours from awareness, whichever expires first governing. If classification occurs after those twenty-four hours, Article #(#) of Delegated Regulation (EU) #/# deals with the case separately.
texte.Déclarez l’unité de facturation « requêt: Declare the billing unit “requests” where that is the case: systems billed per token will come out with hosting not counted, and the reporting will have to say so.
texte.Déclarez si vous êtes fournisseur, déplo: Declare whether you are a provider, a deployer or both, and whether the system identifies persons remotely through biometrics.
texte.Déclarez vos produits et choisissez leur: Declare your products and choose their class. Start with the one you are unsure about, not the simplest one.
texte.Déclencher les prélèvements Stripe pour: Trigger the Stripe direct debits for all instalments due? This action really debits the clients.
texte.Déclenchées sur suspicion de fraude et s: Triggered on suspicion of fraud and on low customer ratings
texte.Découpez en jalons trimestriels — un pro: Break it down into quarterly milestones — a programme without intermediate stages loses visibility after #-# months.
texte.Découvrez les briques du dispositif et l: Discover the building blocks of the framework and the global compliance index.
texte.Décrivez le système (étape #), répondez: Describe the system (step #), answer the classification questions (step #), indicate your current practices (step #), specify the GPAI/data aspects if relevant (step #), then consult the detailed result (step #). You can then add it directly to the AI register, save the simulation to history, or run the full audit.
texte.Décrivez qui qualifie un incident d’« im: Describe who qualifies an incident as “significant”, and at what point.
texte.Définir clairement votre rôle (fournisse: Clearly define your role (provider, deployer, or both)
texte.Définir des indicateurs de performance d: Define AIMS performance indicators and monitor them regularly
texte.Définir et mesurer les niveaux d'exactit: Define and measure target accuracy levels
texte.Définir le périmètre du mandat (vérifica: Define the scope of the mandate (verification of the declaration of conformity, cooperation with authorities)
texte.Définir les critères déclenchant une int: Define the criteria that trigger human intervention
texte.Définir les seuils déclenchant un signal: Define the thresholds that trigger reporting to the authorities
texte.Définir un plan d'action correctif (mise: Define a corrective action plan (bringing into compliance, withdrawal, deactivation, recall)
texte.Définir une période de support et la com: Define a support period and communicate it
texte.Définit les termes clés (# points, auxqu: Defines the key terms (# points, to which Regulation (EU) #/# adds SMEs — #(#a) — and small mid-cap enterprises — #(#b)). AI system: a machine-based system designed to operate with varying levels of autonomy and that may exhibit adaptiveness after deployment and that, for explicit or implicit objectives, infers, from the input it receives, how to generate outputs such as predictions, content, recommendations or decisions that can influence physical or virtual environments (#(#)). Safety component (#(#)): redefined by the same Regulation around the safety function and the health or safety of persons and property.
texte.Définitions clés : système IA, fournisse: Key definitions: AI system, provider, deployer (Art. #)
texte.Déjà certifié ISO # — qu’est-ce que # aj: Already ISO # certified — what does # add?
texte.Déjà certifié ISO #:# — qu’est-ce qui a: Already ISO #:# certified — what has changed?
texte.Délai de présélection −# % ; volume trai: Pre-selection time −# %; volume handled without extra staff.
texte.Délai de récupération : temps d’amortiss: Payback period: time to recover the project cost.
texte.Démontre une trajectoire (amélioration o: Shows a trajectory (improvement or deterioration) rather than an isolated snapshot — far more convincing in a committee.
texte.Département qui utilise le système (RH,: Department that uses the system (HR, IT, Marketing, Finance…).
texte.Dépend du produit final. Vérifier si le: Depends on the final product. Check whether the product falls under Annex III.
texte.Dépend — risque limité sauf si décisions: Depends — limited risk unless decisions are made about people (HR, credit)
texte.Déplace la charge sur la revue, qui devi: Shifts the burden onto the review, which becomes the real checkpoint. Only choose it if the reviewers have the time and the mandate to refuse.
texte.Déplace la conversation de « faut-il le: Moves the conversation from “should we do it” to “where do those who did it stand” — and it is the only one of the two that reaches a conclusion.
texte.Déplace la discussion de « est-ce faisab: Moves the discussion from “is it feasible” to “where do those who did it stand”.
texte.Dépliez la catégorie sur laquelle vous t: Expand the category you are working on and use its points as a list of evidence to request.

Expand the category you are working on and use the points as a list of evidence to request. The statements are in English and verbatim, deliberately: a translated document can no longer be found in the source the day the auditor asks where it is written.
texte.Déployeur : informer les personnes expos: Deployer: inform the persons exposed to emotion recognition or biometric categorisation (Art. #(#))
texte.Déployeur : signaler les hypertrucages e: Deployer: disclose deepfakes and published texts of public interest, unless there has been human review or editorial control (Art. #(#))
texte.Déployeur — j’emploie un système acheté: Deployer — I use a system I bought
texte.Déployeurs de systèmes à haut risque : p: Deployers of high-risk systems: take measures to use the system in accordance with the instructions for use (#(#)), assign human oversight to persons who are competent, trained and authorised (#(#)), ensure the relevance and representativeness of the input data they control (#(#)), monitor the operation and inform the provider (#(#)). In case of risk: inform the provider or distributor and the market surveillance authority without undue delay, and suspend use; in case of a serious incident: first inform the provider immediately, then the importer or distributor and the authorities. Keep the logs for at least six months (#(#)), inform workers' representatives and the workers concerned before any use in the workplace (#(#)), inform the persons who are subject to an Annex III decision (#(#)), cooperate with the authorities (#(#)).
texte.Déployez des modules de formation ciblés: Roll out training modules targeted by role (developer, business, executive).
texte.Déposez la documentation technique, la d: Upload the technical documentation, the EU declaration of conformity and the Annex II instructions received from the manufacturer.
texte.Déposez les livrables de cadrage, les gr: Upload the scoping deliverables, the decision grids and the lessons learned.
texte.Déposez les supports, les procédures et: Upload the materials, procedures and exercise minutes to the knowledge base, organised by skill and not by session.
texte.Déroulez les # étapes de classification: Go through the # classification steps for one case.
texte.Déroulez les cinq étapes de classificati: Go through the five classification steps for each system hosted or operated.
texte.Désignation et lettre de mission du DPO: Designation and engagement letter of the DPO
texte.Désigner et former des superviseurs huma: Designate and train competent human overseers
texte.Désigner un point de contact pour la not: Designate a point of contact for notification to the authorities (ANSSI/CSIRT)
texte.Désigner un point de contact pour les au: Designate a point of contact for the authorities (CERT-FR in France)
texte.Désigner un responsable conformité AI Ac: Designate an internal AI Act compliance lead
texte.Désigner un responsable de la gestion de: Designate a person responsible for ICT risk management at senior management level
texte.Désigner un responsable de la gouvernanc: Designate an AI governance lead with authority and resources
texte.Désignez nommément les personnes chargée: Name the people responsible for oversight, and check that they have the competence, the time AND the authority to override an output of the system.
texte.Détail du cadre applicable à une juridic: Details of the framework applicable in a jurisdiction: texts in force or in draft, competent authority, severity level, points to watch. One profile per country, accessible from the world map or the comparator.
texte.Détection anticipée des défaillances ; r: Early detection of failures; fewer supply shortages.
texte.Détection d'intrusion par ML, réponse au: ML-based intrusion detection, automated incident response, network behaviour analytics (UEBA)
texte.Détection de chute, capteurs de présence: Fall detection, presence sensors in the home: Article # of the GDPR, and certified hosting as soon as the data becomes health data.
texte.Détection de présence et d'atmosphère :: Presence and atmosphere detection: failure is paid for in lives. Effective human oversight (art. #) and an emergency stop independent of the system.
texte.Détection de risques sur chantier par vi: Vision-based risk detection on construction sites
texte.Détermine en quelques minutes le niveau: Determines in a few minutes the risk level and the exact legal obligations — avoids discovering a critical obligation too late in the project.
texte.Détermine la classification d un système: Determines the classification of an AI system (prohibited, high-risk, limited risk, minimal) and its associated obligations, by answering # guided steps — before even recording it in the register.
texte.Détermine si vous restez déployeur ou si: Determines whether you remain a deployer or have become a PROVIDER without knowing it. It is the switch organisations discover the latest, usually after fine-tuning a model they bought.
texte.Détermine, pour chaque traitement du reg: Determines, for each processing activity in the records, whether an impact assessment is required, according to the CNIL’s nine criteria. Two criteria together make a DPIA necessary.
texte.Déterminer l'accès, l'admission ou l'aff: Determining access, admission or assignment; evaluating learning outcomes; assessing the appropriate level of education a person will be able to reach; monitoring and detecting prohibited behaviour during tests. The point covers “all levels”. An institution that does any one of the four is a deployer of a high-risk system.
texte.Déterminer votre rôle (fournisseur, dépl: Determine your role (provider, deployer, importer, distributor — Art. #(#) to #(#)) before listing the obligations
texte.Déterminez les traitements nécessitant u: Identify the processing activities requiring a DPIA and assess their risks.
texte.Déterminez tôt si un organisme notifié d: Determine early whether a notified body must be involved: its lead time drives your whole timetable.
texte.EFFACEMENT RGPD — supprimer les données: GDPR ERASURE — delete the KYC data, notes, reminders and follow-up, and anonymise the personal contact details of this client’s account? Invoices and contracts are kept (linked by a pseudonymised identifier) under the #-year statutory accounting obligation. The account will be deactivated. This action is irreversible.
texte.EU AI Act — Entrée en vigueur obligation: EU AI Act — Entry into force of high-risk AI obligations
texte.Effacer de ce navigateur les réponses: Clear from this browser the answers
texte.Effacer les choix de politique enregistr: Clear the policy choices saved in this browser?
texte.Effacer les relevés d’adoption enregistr: Clear the adoption readings saved in this browser?
texte.Effet juridique, ou effet significatif s: Legal effect, or similarly significant effect, on the person
texte.Elle agrège ce qui a été saisi ailleurs: It aggregates what was entered elsewhere and is not filled in here. An incomplete AI register produces a reassuring and false executive view: check the register before presenting the summary.
texte.Elle dit qui est connecté, sous quelle o: It says who is signed in, under which plan, and gives the only two routes that matter: sign out, or sign in. Sentinel had fifty-two tabs and not one spoke of the account — the session existed only in a button in the top bar, between two buttons that looked the same.
texte.Elle décrit un rapport de force, pas un: It describes a balance of power, not a right
texte.Elle engage l’organisation sur des oblig: It commits the organisation to obligations whose cost is counted in months.
texte.Elle est au stade de l’Enquête CEN : sa: It is at the CEN Enquiry stage: its reference is NOT cited in the Official Journal of the European Union. Meeting it therefore opens NO presumption of conformity with article #. The day it is cited, the same work will carry a presumption — within the limits of its scope.
texte.Elle est à notifier à l’autorité de surv: It must be notified to the market surveillance authority — allow for the corresponding lead time in your timetable.
texte.Elle ne chiffre PAS le coût de votre mis: It does NOT cost your compliance effort — neither person-days nor notified body fees. These figures are neither in the Regulation nor reliably public, and inventing them would produce a document that looks like a quote without being one: it would be cited in committee. And the amounts displayed are CEILINGS, never forecasts: Article #(#) requires account to be taken of the nature, gravity and duration of the infringement, the operator’s history and its size. The penalty regime itself is set by each Member State.
texte.Elle ne choisit pas l’approche à votre p: It does not choose the approach for you: the Regulation leaves that choice free, and a module that designated one would have you mistake its opinion for the text. Nor does it hide the cost of the choice: a requirement on « another standard » or « another solution » whose three pieces are missing does not leave the « strategy » share half-done — it caps it, and the cap comes back down onto the overall rate.
texte.Elle ne classe pas les douze risques par: It does not rank the twelve risks by severity: the order is alphabetical in the document, and NIST declined to set a hierarchy. It takes nothing away from the work done on the framework — it bounds what can be said of it for a generative system. And # of the # sub-categories carry no action: they are not applicable FOR THE PROFILE, never « not covered ».
texte.Elle ne compte jamais une case vide comm: It never counts an empty box as a green box: the number of rows not provided is displayed next to the rate, on purpose. And ticking all ten does not prove compliance — the Article says “at least”, and proportionality is assessed against your actual exposure, your size and the likely severity of incidents.

It never counts an empty box as a green box. The rate displayed always comes with the number of rows not provided, because a rate calculated on three requirements says nothing about the other eighteen — and that is the one shown in committee. “Not applicable” is a reasoned decision that leaves the denominator; “not provided” is an absence of decision, which stays in it.
texte.Elle ne conserve rien : elle interroge l: It keeps nothing: it queries the session each time it opens, because a stored state would be wrong at the very moment you come to consult it. And signing out ends the session on this browser only — the register, the audit and the documents stay attached to the account.
texte.Elle ne contrôle pas que l’adresse saisi: It does not check that the address entered is actually in Île-de-France: outside that area, write before booking. It keeps only ONE session per slot, and the same topic only once per company — the SIRET, not the email address, counts the free session.
texte.Elle ne cote rien à votre place et n’imp: It rates nothing on your behalf and imposes no scale: the standard prescribes none, the one proposed is the firm’s, and it says so. Nor does it consider a risk treated because a plan exists: as long as the measures are not declared implemented, the residual level entered remains a forecast and the module keeps the initial level. Finally, it reproduces no sentence of the standard — numbers and titles only.
